info.bio:
Moonshake was a British-based experimental rock/post-rock band, existing between 1991 and 1997. The only consistent member was singer/sampler player/occasional guitarist David Callahan, who initially co-led the project with Margaret Fiedler (Fiedler and bass player John Frenett left Moonshake in 1993 to form the more commercially successful Laika).

The band was notable for its extensive use of textures and sampler technology in a rock context. In his 1996 article on Krautrock and its influences

podcast.title: Early 90s UK Post-Rock Scene
podcast.body: Moonshake is identified as a band from the early 1990s UK post-rock scene, noted for their jazz-style rhythms, spacious production, atmospherics, and dynamics. "write down these band names, Lika, C. Field, Moon Shake, and Disco and Ferno."
